mentions.claim_text: He says he saw five lizard people, five different branches or generations of reptilians, all of them different kinds and all of them here, and asks why he is seeing them.
mentions.quote: I saw five lizard people
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim concerns unseen beings.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He recommends small books on the gift of prophecy and on praying to get results by a named teacher, notes the prices, and says he and his wife use them every day driving.
mentions.quote: we use this every day, my wife and I
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a reading recommendation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says to turn his own channel off and not watch him if there is no accuracy to what he warned about Venezuela and they do not see it in the news, that he does not want to cause confusion in their houses, that he believes the Lord told him to do this but could have missed it, and that he hates dogmatism and pride.
mentions.quote: if there's no accuracy to it with Venezuela then please turn it off
mentions.falsify_match: The Venezuela warnings appear in the news as he described them.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not, in which case he has told the audience in advance what to do about it.

mentions.claim_text: He says this concerns Taiwan and the valley of decision, that he sees red all around Taiwan like acid rain and a red sky or red dawn, and Australia looking on, looking up and looking out and over.
mentions.quote: I see red all around Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: An event over Taiwan that the red resolves to.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He does not say what the red is.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing Mexico coming up alongside America and trying to join the dollar, so that the dollar and Mexico would be one and there would no longer be a peso, and calls it a business decision about the economy.
mentions.quote: Mexico will be one and no longer peso
mentions.falsify_match: Mexico adopts the dollar and retires the peso.

mentions.claim_text: He says stability will come throughout South America and all of Mexico after corruption that has gone on too long, that this is the Lord's hand in it, and that a major revival will come to South America, to the Spanish people and to the Portuguese.
mentions.quote: A major revival will come to the South America, to the Spanish people
mentions.falsify_match: A documented religious movement across South America.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is about to happen concerning Iran is mainly Israel with America backing it, on the pattern of the earlier strike operation but that this one will be bigger.
mentions.quote: Kind of like the Midnight Hammer
mentions.falsify_match: An Israeli-led strike on Iran larger than the June 2025 American operation.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is about to happen in Iran is set in stone, has already happened, is already in motion, that they are next and that Iran will be taken quickly.
mentions.quote: What is about to happen in Iran is set in stone
mentions.falsify_match: Iran falls quickly to an Israeli or American action.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He attaches no prayer clause and no condition, which is unusual for him and removes the usual escape.

mentions.claim_text: Prompted about the Israeli law of return, he says he sees a lot of people leaving New York, sees it again, and that there will be great antisemitism, even greater in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: I see a lot of people leaving New York
mentions.falsify_match: Departures from New York under the law of return.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees people occupying and taking land in Gaza, building houses and doing things there, and that the Lord said the land of Gaza belongs to Israel.
mentions.quote: The Lord said the the land of Gaza belongs to Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Israeli settlement building inside Gaza.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the land of Gaza belongs to Israel and says this is not being politically correct, adding that it is what the Lord just said.
mentions.quote: That's what the Lord just said. It's not being politically correct
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; a statement about ownership of land.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the decisions the president takes under great pressure concerning Gaza, Israel and the days ahead for Iran, and says the president has a hand to hold.
mentions.quote: He is great pressure on the decisions that he makes
mentions.falsify_match: A decisive presidential choice on these three.

mentions.claim_text: He apologises for pausing, says he camped there looking, that he sees so much and that his natural language cannot tell them all he sees, because everything has so much colour and detail.
mentions.quote: my na natural language cannot tell you all that I see
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement about his own limits.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, though it is a built-in reason any detail can be missing.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything is so detailed that night, that he takes it and puts it inside him, and that he can go across America and see Mexico and Asia.
mentions.quote: everything is so detailed tonight
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a description of the experience.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no content given.

mentions.claim_text: He says much prayer is required over their land, over Israel, over what is coming for Iran and for liberation for the people, and that a major revival is coming.
mentions.quote: for liberation for the people, for for a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: A documented religious movement in Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He says he cannot draw a picture of what he saw and the only comparison he can give is the film Stargate, and asks whether it is happening now or further in the future because he does not know.
mentions.quote: the only thing I can tell you is Stargate the movie
mentions.falsify_match: A portal-like technology matching the description.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appears. He says outright that he does not know when it is.

mentions.claim_text: He says he assumed they were going to use tactical nuclear weapons and the Lord said no, it is a weapon never used before on the earth, with a blast zone of a fifty mile radius or bigger that vaporised things.
mentions.quote: this is a weapon that has never been used before, ever on the earth
mentions.falsify_match: A weapon of a new type used with a blast radius on that scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is used. Recording that he corrects his own first reading of tactical nuclear weapons.

mentions.claim_text: He says China is making a new kind of drone, not for the sky but for the battlefield, so that soldiers do not have to be brought out and they fight drone wars, and describes a circular shield like the one in the film Alien.
mentions.quote: They were drones for battlefield
mentions.falsify_match: Chinese ground combat drones of that description enter service.

mentions.claim_text: He says they had fifty calibre guns on tracks and China was using drone warfare for battle, and points at an image on screen as matching the shield he saw.
mentions.quote: They had 50 caliber guns with tracks
mentions.falsify_match: Tracked armed drones of that description are fielded.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. The confirmation offered here is an image shown on the programme rather than an event.

mentions.claim_text: He says the level of technological advancement is endless and that the Lord showed him people putting codes into the collider, opening demonic portals through which they are talking to demonic spirits, which is why he keeps warning about it.
mentions.quote: people putting in these codes through CERN and this demonic portals
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing checkable; the claim concerns spirits.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing can falsify it as put.

mentions.claim_text: He says people were selling any gold they had because of the all-time highs he saw coming, and that he saw people going into old dormant mines in Colorado, Utah and parts of California.
mentions.quote: I saw people going in old mines and I saw Colorado
mentions.falsify_match: Old American mines reopened as gold rises.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw people looking through creek beds in Colorado and places they could pan for gold, and a gold rush with excitement at the idea that finding a little would be worth a substantial amount.
mentions.quote: I saw a gold rush with people of an excitement
mentions.falsify_match: Amateur prospecting rises measurably.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard the words new gold rush in the headlines and that this was worldwide but especially in America, with people going into old mines that were dangerous.
mentions.quote: I heard new gold rush in the headlines
mentions.falsify_match: The phrase new gold rush appears in headlines worldwide.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. A headline phrase is checkable, which is more than most of the batch offers.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether anyone remembers the black twenty five, says he keeps seeing it come up out of the ground and still does not know what it is, believes it may be a rate, and says it was written on a small pink piece of paper of a lower denomination.
mentions.quote: I keep seeing this 25 come up out of the ground
mentions.falsify_match: The number resolves to a named rate or note.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He says twice that he does not know what it is.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the Saudi crown prince leading Arab men in a V like ducks flying, going into Israel and negotiating over Gaza with the American president and other countries, after which they rebuilt Gaza, and he saw a golf course with the president's name on it and a flag in the ninth hole.
mentions.quote: I saw MBS leading in a V
mentions.falsify_match: The Saudi crown prince leads Arab states into a Gaza settlement.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is something more about the ninth hole, that it is a type and a shadow and a code, that he does not know codes and only sees this and prays over it, and that the flag was not a normal-looking flag.
mentions.quote: There's something to this. It's a code
mentions.falsify_match: The number resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He says he does not read codes.

mentions.claim_text: He says the flag had Gaza written on it in blue and white in cursive with Trump golf course, and blue outlining like an Israeli flag, and that it was in the ninth hole.
mentions.quote: it said Trump golf course and it was in beautiful cursive writing
mentions.falsify_match: A golf development bearing that name in Gaza.

mentions.claim_text: He says a massive amount of money in oil and gas lies underneath the soil of Gaza and under the Mediterranean outside the coastline, and that he saw the Saudi crown prince come on the scene with it.
mentions.quote: a massive amount of money in oil and gas underneath the soil of Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: Commercial development of the offshore field.
mentions.falsify_miss: None proceeds. The Gaza Marine field is long-documented, so the existence of the gas is not itself a hit.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were building a golf course on Gaza with the president's name on it, and adds that he prays this is before the rapture because he would pray that the president and his family make it.
mentions.quote: I pray this is before the rapture
mentions.falsify_match: The development is built.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. He says he has seen part and heard part, which is his usual caveat.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Ferraris and Mercedes and something that looked like Monaco, where the rich go, and works out the name with his co-host.
mentions.quote: I saw Ferraris. I saw Mercedes-Benz
mentions.falsify_match: A luxury resort district built on the Gaza coast.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was taken to America and saw five pots with a blessing in each one, and that the Lord warned him about each of the pots.
mentions.quote: I saw those five pots. And I saw blessing in each one
mentions.falsify_match: The pots resolve to identifiable sectors or funds.

mentions.claim_text: He says one of the pots had a western theme with a covered wagon or stagecoach in the background.
mentions.quote: it looked like a a a um covered wagon
mentions.falsify_match: The wagon resolves to something identifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was looking out of the vision in front of a named bank and saw the founder and chief executive of a named asset manager.
mentions.quote: it was in front of the Bank of America
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable action by the named firm.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man was connected to Canada and to New York but not to the other banks, identifies him from a picture shown on screen, and says he is not a good man and that there was darkness.
mentions.quote: That's the man. He is not a good man
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable action by the named man.
mentions.falsify_miss: None follows. The identification is made from a picture put in front of him rather than named first.

mentions.claim_text: He describes going slowly over rocks and a creek bed because speed would break the car, then says the Lord said he needs his people to move faster because they are running out of time, and that he saw time and money being sped up while America's economy is not as good as stated.
mentions.quote: I need my people to move faster for they're running out of time
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration in events.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. Acceleration language cannot be scored either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says this was Satan's will house and that Satan has a hold of the money as a specialty, that he prayed over it a lot, and then that he saw people picketing at Gaza saying Free Palestine, upset that the land was not being given back, with picketing in America too.
mentions.quote: Satan has a hold of the money
mentions.falsify_match: Protests in America over the Gaza rebuilding.

mentions.claim_text: He says the picketers were shouting Free Palestine because they were angry about the land and the resort being built, and that he also saw people very angry about Greenland while the president was trying to acquire it.
mentions.quote: I saw major ticked off people concerning Greenland
mentions.falsify_match: Public anger over both at once.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the French president yelling the loudest and very upset about it in the days ahead, with England, Germany and Italy raising loud voices against it, almost like an invasion again.
mentions.quote: I saw Emmanuel Macron yelling the loudest
mentions.falsify_match: European leaders publicly opposing an American move on Greenland.

mentions.claim_text: He says the reason it was happening so quickly was that the dollar was in trouble and the president was trying to save an economy worse than stated, and recalls the dam he saw.
mentions.quote: The reason it was happening so quickly was because the dollar was in trouble
mentions.falsify_match: A dollar crisis forcing rapid action.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was so bad they sent in the National Guard and put barbed wire fence around everything in all the major cities, naming Chicago, New York and Philadelphia, with nobody out on the streets.
mentions.quote: they sent in the National Guard and put barbed wire fence around everything
mentions.falsify_match: Guard deployments with barbed wire cordons in those cities.

mentions.claim_text: He says it started to turn red and to become a state, that not all of Canada did it at once but parts began to secede because of a vote and because the economy was in trouble, and that he saw Canada and America try something.
mentions.quote: parts of Canada started to secede from Canada because of a vote
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian province votes to secede and join America.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw hearts joining together in Japan, a pink heart and a dark red one, and a covered wagon with the Sooners on it again, and that they will be major crypto people in the days ahead with their economies joining with South Korea.
mentions.quote: I saw hearts joining up together in Japan
mentions.falsify_match: Japan and South Korea move together on crypto.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Cuba and Russia becoming friends with a lifeline being given to them, military equipment and things being brought, and that he believes this is something already happening, naming Venezuela, Russia and Cuba.
mentions.quote: I saw Cuba and Russia becoming friends
mentions.falsify_match: Russian military supply to Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is seeing Russian troops coming into Venezuela and asks how that is possible given how stretched they are with Ukraine, answers that there are not very many, and says they claim to be trying to keep the peace.
mentions.quote: I'm seeing Russian troops coming into Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: Russian forces deploy to Venezuela.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be a turf war involving Russia over Venezuela in the days ahead and that Cuba is now involved and trying to devise a plan.
mentions.quote: A turf war involving Russia concerning Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: An armed contest involving Russia over Venezuela.

mentions.claim_text: He says American forces are on the ground right now taking out key targets like an invasion, that he sees cocaine plants being blown up with powder burning, and Marines and men trained like Navy SEALs bringing people out.
mentions.quote: Our people are on the ground right now taking out key targets
mentions.falsify_match: American ground operations against drug facilities are confirmed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None are. He states this as present fact rather than as forecast, which makes it checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are probably ten thousand of them coming through Brazil into Venezuela from the east, wanting to be seen as peacemakers coming to regulate.
mentions.quote: there's probably 10,000 of them. Coming through Brazil into Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: A force of that size crosses from Brazil.

mentions.claim_text: He says Cuba will go along with Russia, that they are not all Russian soldiers but Cuban, only a couple of them really trained combat men, and that Cuba knows the territory.
mentions.quote: But Cuba will go along with Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Cuban personnel deploy alongside Russians.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what it does if they come in and answers that it just raises tension, and describes the drug lords and young men in white t-shirts and blue jeans.
mentions.quote: It just raises tension
mentions.falsify_match: Irregular fighters of that description are documented.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is not just about America's drugs but Europe's, that it is a cocaine trafficking highway running throughout Europe and through America, and that he sees it going into Canada and parts of Asia.
mentions.quote: It's a cocaine drug highway
mentions.falsify_match: Enforcement action documenting that route.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. That cocaine reaches Europe through these routes is long established, so this is not a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a clashing of two fronts concerning Russia, America and Cuba, says it is mainly Cuba, that Cuba is asking Russia for help, and recalls the lines he described before.
mentions.quote: Cuba is asking Russia for help
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuban request for Russian military help.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man over Cuba is underground in the side of a cliff with a light on and soldiers around him, wearing a blue shirt.
mentions.quote: The man in Cuba is down under the ground
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban leader is found to have gone into a bunker.

mentions.claim_text: He says the man is communicating that they want to take their people and military over through Brazil into Venezuela to cause jungle warfare against American troops, and says the vision is very detailed and very clear.
mentions.quote: come over onto Venezuela and cause uh jungle warfare against our troops
mentions.falsify_match: Irregular warfare against American troops in Venezuela.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees big factories with workers outside like slave labourers making cocaine, down by Venezuela, Cuba and Colombia, that Cuba is trying to protect these assets, and that the drug lords are scrambling to pay because they know America is coming.
mentions.quote: workers that are like slave workers all outside of these factories
mentions.falsify_match: Facilities of that description are found and destroyed.

mentions.claim_text: He says the drug lords are scrambling to pay because they know America is coming, that he sees Colombia very clearly, and that the drug lords are paying Cuba to come and help protect them.
mentions.quote: the drug lords are paying Cuba to come and help protec
mentions.falsify_match: Cuban personnel paid by cartels are documented.
